exact layout.
- **How V is read:** head 2 puts the place value in the score and the digit in the value, rather than putting log(digit·place) in the score.

I kept the original's limitations rather than fixing them. Leakage around the huge sink scores is roughly 1e-12 relative, which is why float64 is needed. One wrong digit also corrupts the remainder X and every digit after it. I didn't run a float32 test to confirm that it breaks.

Final model: `interpretable_transformers_lib/SinkExpMul_v1.py`
